# reallog-agent

A small Python client for logging **text descriptions of camera scenes** to a
PLATO tile server and querying them back with keyword matching. Each logged
scene becomes one tile in the `reallog-ai` room. This package handles no
images, video, or camera hardware — the caller supplies the description as a
string.

## Installation

```bash
pip install reallog-agent
```

## Quick Start

```python
from reallog_agent import RealLogAgent

agent = RealLogAgent(camera_id="security_cam_1")
agent.log_scene("front_door", "person approaching at 14:32", motion=True)
agent.log_scene("back_yard", "bird detected", motion=False)
print(agent.ask("who came to the front door?"))
```

## Status & capabilities

Markers follow this org's convention: ✅ real today / ⚠️ real but conditional /
🔮 later phase.

- ✅ **`log_scene(scene_type, description, motion=False)`** — writes one tile
  (`question`, `answer`, `confidence`, metadata with `camera_id`, `scene_type`,
  `motion`, `timestamp`) to `POST {plato_url}/room/reallog-ai`. Returns `False`
  on any failure.
- ✅ **`ask(question)`** — fetches the last 50 tiles from the room and filters
  them by matching the first three words of your question against the tile
  text (case-insensitive substring match). It is keyword matching and
  summarization, not language understanding.
- ✅ **`don_shell(camera_id)`** — returns a new `RealLogAgent` bound to a
  different `camera_id` against the same server. That is all "viewing from
  another camera's perspective" means here: a re-scoped client, not any kind
  of vision transfer.
- ⚠️ **Requires a reachable PLATO server** (default `http://localhost:8847`).
  This package is a client only; it does not ship or run PLATO itself. With no
  server reachable, `log_scene` returns `False` and `ask` returns
  `"Camera system unavailable."`.
- ⚠️ **`detect_emergence` / `check_consensus`** — thin wrappers around the
  `fleet-agent` dependency's experimental `fleet_math` module
  (`EmergenceDetector`, `HolonomyConsensus`). They run, but they are research
  scaffolding inherited from the base class's ecosystem, not a tested product
  feature of this package.
- 🔮 **No camera, vision, or frame processing exists in this package.**
  Connecting real cameras (frame capture, scene description via a vision
  model) is the direction the name points at; today the description string is
  the caller's job.

## PLATO, in one line

PLATO is the SuperInstance sketchbook's shared tile-server memory: a **room**
is a named collection on the server, a **tile** is one JSON record in it.
Sibling clients of the same protocol:
[fishinglog-agent](https://github.com/SuperInstance/fishinglog-agent),
[activeledger-agent](https://github.com/SuperInstance/activeledger-agent).

## Requirements

- Python 3.10+
- `fleet-agent >= 0.2.0` (the `RealLogAgent` class extends its `BaseAgent`)
- `requests >= 2.28`
- A reachable PLATO server (see above)
